operators.name: Wisconsin Humane Society
operators.area: Milwaukee and other Wisconsin campuses, US

prep.label: Where to go
prep.text: Use the wish list’s campus directory to confirm the appropriate drop-off location.

prep.label: Condition
prep.text: The wish list asks for new or gently used towels.

prep.label: Where to go
prep.text: Bring in-person donations to the Pet Help Center and give them to staff. Keep items with you until the center can receive them.

prep.label: Large donations
prep.text: Arrange an appointment with the organization before bringing a large quantity.

prep.label: Where to go
prep.text: The county directs donations to the bench outside its intake area. Follow the published drop-off directions.

prep.label: Receipt
prep.text: The county directs people who need a receipt to visit during regular business hours.

prep.label: Where to go
prep.text: Check the wish list and current visitor information before bringing a donation.

prep.label: Sheets and towels
prep.text: The wish list groups several kinds of bedding together. Ask about shape, size or condition if your item is unclear.

prep.label: Where to go
prep.text: The Christchurch page directs linen, towels and blankets for animal care to the centre during opening hours.

prep.label: Channel
prep.text: Use the centre’s donation route for pet bedding and its separate Op Shop instructions for goods intended for resale.

operators.name: Casa Grande Animal Care and Adoption Center

prep.label: Where to go
prep.text: Use the address and contact information on the city’s current donation guide.

prep.label: Condition
prep.text: The city excludes heavily used and unwashed donations.

prep.label: Where to go
prep.text: Use the marked donation bins at the shelter during its published business hours.

prep.label: Condition
prep.text: The shelter asks for clean, gently used linens.

rules.text: The wish list names new or gently used towels. It gives no size breakdown for hand towels or washcloths.
The wish list names new or gently used towels. Confirm your towel size with the campus.
The wish list excludes fitted sheets.
The wish list excludes comforters, quilts and oversized blankets.
The wish list excludes pillows.
The published list includes hand towels and washcloths.
The organization’s current needs list says it does not need large towels. Recheck the list before a later trip.
The organization lists flat bed sheets for bedding.
The list explicitly excludes fitted sheets.
The organization lists comforters among items it cannot accept.
The list excludes pillows and cushions.
The county lists towels and specifically names washcloths.
The county lists towels generally, without stating a large-towel rule.
The shelter lists sheets among items it can use and separately excludes fitted sheets.
The county lists fitted sheets among items the shelter cannot use.
The county excludes pillows.
The shelter lists towels in general. Confirm hand-towel or washcloth size with the shelter.
The shelter lists towels in general. Confirm large bath towels before you go.
The shelter expressly names comforters. Confirm unusually bulky items ahead of a trip.
The shelter expressly excludes pillows.
The linked national animal-centre list accepts towels generally. Confirm whether the centre can use hand towels or washcloths.
The national list accepts towels generally, without a size breakdown.
The national list names sheets without distinguishing flat and fitted. Confirm your sheet type with the centre.
The national list names sheets generally. It does not specify fitted sheets, so confirm with the centre.
The national animal-centre list excludes filled duvet inserts and separately accepts duvet covers.
The linked national list excludes pillows for animal-centre donations.
The city expressly lists hand towels. Ask first if bringing washcloths alone.
The city expressly includes large bath towels.
The city puts fitted sheets in its list of donations it declines.
The shelter lists towels without naming hand towels or washcloths separately.
The shelter lists towels without giving a size boundary. Confirm large bath towels with staff.
The shelter lists flat sheets among requested linen donations.
The shelter limits its stated sheet acceptance to non-fitted sheets.
